title: GA-VINO: A Geometry-Aware Variational Physics-informed Neural Operator for Mindlin-Reissner Plates
abstract: arXiv:2606.16624v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Plate and shell structures are widely used in engineering fields. Rapid response prediction for such structures under complex geometries, heterogeneous materials, and varying loads is important for engineering design, but conventional numerical methods usually require repeated modeling and solution when the physical configuration changes. translated_title: GA-VINO：一种面向Mindlin-Reissner板的几何感知变分物理信息神经算子
translated_abstract: 板壳结构广泛应用于工程领域。对这类结构在复杂几何、非均质材料和变化载荷下的响应进行快速预测对工程设计十分重要，但传统数值方法在物理构型发生变化时通常需要重复建模和求解。为解决这一问题，本研究提出了一种面向Mindlin-Reissner板的几何感知变分物理信息神经算子（GA-VINO）。GA-VINO使用边界点云表示板的几何形状，并结合材料编码器、载荷编码器和标量参数分支，以处理空间随机材料场、空间变化压力载荷以及样本级统一参数。通过多分支点云编码和交叉注意力机制，GA-VINO融合几何、材料、载荷和查询点信息，预测任意位置的横向挠度和转角。
tldr: 该研究提出GA-VINO，一种几何感知的变分物理信息神经算子，通过边界点云及材料、载荷、标量参数的多分支编码与交叉注意力融合，能够快速预测复杂几何、非均质材料和变化载荷下Mindlin-Reissner板在任意位置的挠度与转角响应，避免了传统数值方法的重复建模与求解。
en_tdlr: GA-VINO is a geometry-aware variational physics-informed neural operator that uses boundary point clouds with material, load, and scalar-parameter encoders to rapidly predict deflections and rotations of Mindlin-Reissner plates under varying geometries, materials, and loads without repeated numerical modeling.
